notes.title: Performance Update 1.11 Released!
notes.notes:
We are very happy to roll out this new performance update for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore! 

This patch should give you a solid 15-20% increase in FPS while also improving the overall smoothness of the game.

We hope you enjoy the improved experience and there are more OEM vehicles on the way shortly! 

Rainbow Studios

notes.title: MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore Update 1.10
notes.notes:
Thanks to all of the feedback and thorough bug reports that we've received from you since the game has launched we are very happy to roll out this update for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore!

Here's what you can expect and look for once you get this installed and load up your game again:
[list]
[*]Fixed HD rendering not scaling; now properly supports HD and 4K resolutions
[*]Improved overall rendering visuals and performance
[*]Adjusted terrain detail scaling based on resolution and texture setting, improves low-end performance
[*]Fixed "dual terrain" issue
[*]Improved trees' memory usage and corrected rendering on AMD graphics
[*]Improved online connectivity and playlist functionality
[*]Added new Settings options
[*]Linked Turning-Reflex option for keyboard
[*]Graphics Adaptor selection
[*]Fixed issue where Settings were not saving properly
[*]Several other minor bug fixes 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the improved experience and have more DLC including levels and OEM vehicles on the way shortly!

BRAAAAAAAP!!!!!!!

notes.title: We are out of early access! Huge update released!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that we have rolled out the biggest update yet for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore! This release adds the Rhythm Racing mode, more Nationals outdoor tracks, Waypoint Races, all new HD rendering, and improved physics handling! Various bugs have also been addressed.

This will be the last content update as we will now focus on optimizing the game for certain hardware and addressing the last remaining bugs. 

Here are more details about the changes and additions for this update:
-	5 Rhythm Racing tracks
-	9 more National outdoor tracks
-	4 Waypoint races
-	All new graphics kits for bikes
-	All new rider gear
-	Upgraded to HD rendering
-	Reworked and fine-tuned driving physics for bikes and ATVs
-	New Main Menu visuals
-	Various bug fixes

[b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b]  With this major update all player data will be reset.

While you download the update, make sure to watch the brand new launch trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fo4KPBHMJPs

Screenshots:
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/08_Nat.jpg[/img]
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/09_RR.jpg[/img]
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/10_SX.jpg[/img]
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/07_WP.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy and look forward to your feedback! Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Early Access Update #4: Devil’s Playground
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce that we have rolled out another update!  This release addresses various network and crash bugs that should improve your online experience.

The Devil’s Playground Open World environment from MX vs. ATV Alive has also had its first pass done being integrated on to the PC.  You’ll notice that the trees are currently absent however they will be added back in a future update.

Here’s a summary of the bug fixes for this update:
[list]
[*]Alt-tab issues in single and multiplayer
[*]Mic issues in multiplayer
[*]Race position and distance between players in multiplayer not synching up
[*]Incorrect “Join Game” option via Steam friends list has been addressed
[*]Resolved issues that players were having when creating private online matches
[*]Fixed invisible rider/bike
[/list]
Check out the video below to get a preview of the Devil’s Playground Open World (the dunes level) and thank you for your continued support! 
http://youtu.be/n2JCZY84Jk8

notes.title: Supercross Encore Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the next update of MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore is scheduled for mid-July, and it will mark an important milestone for our game. In the update we will be adding the first open world map from Alive allowing you to Free ride and explore in a bigger environment. The update will also feature several bug fixes such as more online improvements along with some added functional stability. 

Since we've been working hard on many under the hood improvements, this also means that we are unable to release any update before mid-July. This is because we are in the middle of development and releasing unfinished code would just make the game less enjoyable for our dear players and supporters.

The next update is a first, important step for Supercross Encore. Now with most of the heavy lifting done on the under the hood improvements we are working on new content to come in the following months: many more tracks from MX vs. ATV Alive, completely new Rhythm Racing events and Waypoint races, true HD rendering for tracks and bikes plus new gear that is officially licensed by top motocross companies.

As always, thank you for your enthusiasm, dedication and support.

Rainbow Studios

notes.title: Early Access Update #2 Outdoor Tracks, UI Overhaul, Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

We've just released an update for the game with bug fixes and new content.  Here's what's in the update:

- The Southwest levels from MX vs. ATV Alive
  - Grandview
  - Piston Valley
  - Catapult Canyon
- Audio Improvements
- Online Multiplayer improvements
- Major UI improvements, including new screens
- Performance Improvements

We are aware that there are terrain issues with some hardware configurations as well as rare crashes on certain setups.  On behalf of the team we would like to thank you for all of the bug reports and feedback in the forums.  You have helped us out tremendously to narrow down issues and improve the game!

- Rainbow Studios

notes.title: MASSIVE Content Update for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we have released our first content update to Early Access and it’s a big one! This release includes: 

- 13 additional tracks from the original MX vs. ATV Supercross 
- Career mode to unlock all of these tracks and bikes 
- 450cc Bikes & ATV’s 
- 650cc Bike & ATV 
- 50cc Mini Bike 

Our next update will address some of the bugs that have been found along with online issues.

Rainbow Studios
